mapper.select: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = 'TI_COP' AND TABLE_NAME NOT IN ('PROMPT_HISTORY','LOGIN_INFO')
SELECT INDEX_NAME, COLUMN_NAME FROM ALL_IND_COLUMNS WHERE INDEX_OWNER = 'TI_COP' AND TABLE_NAME = #{tableName}

SELECT atc.column_name as column_name, CASE WHEN atc.data_type IN ('CHAR','NCHAR','VARCHAR2','NVARCHAR2') THEN atc.data_type || '(' || atc.char_length || ')' WHEN atc.data_type IN ('NUMBER') AND atc.data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN atc.data_type || '(' || atc.data_precision || NVL2(atc.data_scale, ','||atc.data_scale, '') || ')' WHEN atc.data_type IN ('FLOAT') AND atc.data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN atc.data_type || '(' || atc.data_precision || ')' ELSE atc.data_type END AS colume_type FROM all_tab_columns atc WHERE atc.owner = 'TI_COP' AND atc.table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY atc.table_name, atc.column_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROMPT_HISTORY ( UUID , PROMPT_TEXT , RESPONSE_TEXT , USER_ID , MODEL_NAME , CALL_DATE , CALL_TIME , CREATED_AT , UPDATED_AT) VALUES ( #{uuid} , #{prompt_text,jdbcType=CLOB} , #{response_text,jdbcType=CLOB} , #{user_id} , 'GPT-4o' , #{call_date} , #{call_time} , SYSDATE , SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT UUID as uuid, USER_ID as userId, PROMPT_TEXT as promptText, RESPONSE_TEXT as responseText, MODEL_NAME as modelName, CALL_DATE as callDate, CALL_TIME as callTime, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt FROM PROMPT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOGIN_INFO ( USER_ID , PASSWORD , USER_NAME , LOGIN_STATUS , LAST_LOGIN_AT , LAST_LOGOUT_AT , CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES ( #{userId} , #{password} , #{userName} , 'N' , SYSDATE , SYSDATE , SYSDATE , SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE LOGIN_INFO SET LOGIN_STATUS = #{status}, LAST_LOGIN_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'Y' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE LAST_LOGIN_AT END, LAST_LOGOUT_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'N' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE LAST_LOGOUT_AT END, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID as userId , PASSWORD as password , USER_NAME as userName FROM LOGIN_INFO WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
